Germany has historically served as a diplomatic interlocutor but has hardened its posture amid hostage diplomacy cases and IRGC-linked plots in Europe.

If such talks progress, E3 may face a coordination challenge — either aligning with US diplomatic openings or maintaining independent pressure. Signals of E3 being sidelined or actively coordinating with US efforts should be scored as diplomatically significant but not inherently escalatory for this dyad unless E3 explicitly breaks from or contradicts the US track.
